assets.origin: Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-atl-hoe.mjs: a modeled Atlanta night scene with a dimensional Waffle House roadside sign, a gradient night sky, a skyline of the Bank of America Plaza, Westin Peachtree Plaza, Truist Plaza and Georgia-Pacific Tower with lit windows and crowns, a lit elevated road with street lamps, and leafy foreground foliage.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-atmosphere-monoliths.mjs: the scene of ATMOSPHERE REFERENCE, in world coordinates on the preset's floor plane (world y -1.2): four cracked rock monoliths (a tall one at the back left, a heavy one at the back right and two shorter ones leaning in from the sides, each a flat-shaded faceted slab with a chiselled crown) around a tall clear crystal at the centre. Ten parts/materials: the monoliths `back`, `violet`, `left`, `right`, sharing one in-house tileable rock texture set (base colour, normal, metal/roughness and a crack-network emissive mask the preset tints per part); and the crystal's `crystal` (cut-glass body: the preset adds transmission, iridescence and dispersion), `frame` (polished gold edge tubes) and four glowing internal fracture parts `crackLeft`, `crackRight`, `crackBack`, `crackViolet`, one per monolith colour. `high` carries 1024 px textures and an opaque crystal material; `low` is the same model with 512 px textures and a translucent crystal material (that tier draws no refraction).

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-backstreet.mjs from the owner's DVYDRM wordmark master (scripts/cinema2-assets/sources/dvydrm-wordmark-master.svg): the neon sign of BACKSTREET, a glass tube of constant radius traced round each of the master's ten closed contours (outline only, as in the production reference), hung off a black painted brick wall by sixteen clear standoff clips. Three parts/materials: `tubeCores` (the lit neon; every vertex carries Mainframe's circuit attributes `_GLOW_PHASE`, `_MAINFRAME_ROUTE`, `_MAINFRAME_BANK`, `_MAINFRAME_REGION` and `_MAINFRAME_SYSTEM` so the Mainframe lighting programs drive it), `clips`, and `wall` (one large plane with an in-house tileable black-painted brick texture set: base colour, normal, metal/roughness). The sign is centred on the origin in the z = 0 plane, 8.8 units wide, facing +Z; the wall is at z = -0.3. One file serves every quality tier.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-conduit-chamber.mjs: CONDUIT's sci-fi chamber - circular back wall (central disc, stepped and portal rings, spoke sectors with a top pillar, flared T-ribs, diagonal ribs and a pedestal, recessed panels, outer arch), curved side walls carrying the tube flanges, and floor groove rings. Parts `shell`, `trim`, `floorTrim`, `segments` (95 emissive LED strips in 8 groups). Every vertex carries `_GLOW_PHASE` (0 at the chamber axis to 1 at the outer arch) and `_SEGMENT` (group, along, side, random). CONDUIT world coordinates (floor y = 0, facing +Z); pieces below the floor are hidden by the native reflective floor.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-conduit-tubes.mjs: CONDUIT's four chrome energy tubes from bolted side-wall flanges to the wordmark's illuminated outer lip. Parts `pipe`, `channel` (dark channel along the front), `flange`, `coupler` (segmented sleeve and narrow outline socket), `energy` (emissive windows and coupler bands). Every vertex carries `_GLOW_PHASE` (0 at the wall, 1 at the wordmark) and `_SEGMENT` (group = tube, along, side, random per window). CONDUIT world coordinates (floor y = 0, facing +Z).

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-conduit-wordmark.mjs from the owner's DVYDRM wordmark master (scripts/cinema2-assets/sources/dvydrm-wordmark-master.svg) through the shared SVG-relief kit: `outline` chrome ring, `letters` rounded pearl relief (letters, lower sweeps, four-point star), `plate` dark silver back plate, `rim` emissive bands round every letter edge, the ring's inner edge and the full outer silhouette. Every vertex carries `_GLOW_PHASE` and `_SEGMENT` (group, along, side, random). CONDUIT world coordinates: 5.76 units wide, centred on (0, 2.09, 0), floor y = 0, facing +Z.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-dvydrm-logo.mjs from the owner's master DVYDRM logo SVG (scripts/cinema2-assets/sources/dvydrm-logo-master.svg): two parts: `outline` (the thin ring, a bevelled extrusion with a polished gold PBR material) and `crystal` (the cloud body and star as a faceted low-poly gem cut along the owner's facet guide, scripts/cinema2-assets/sources/dvydrm-logo-facet-guides.svg, with a polished near-white metal PBR material), 2 units wide, centred on the origin, facing +Z. Shared by every preset that shows the logo.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-dvydrm-logo.mjs --faceted from the owner's master DVYDRM logo SVG: the cut-crystal variant of the shared logo (RELIQUARY's clear crystal) - the same `outline` ring and a `crystal` body whose rounded profile is cut into flat bands of flat-shaded facets with a little seeded jitter, so a transmissive material reads as cut glass. 2 units wide, centred on the origin, facing +Z.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-golden-roots.mjs (revision 3): a hand-authored curve network matching the owner's reference - a trunk of four twisting strands rising from a flare of fourteen snaking roots with rootlets, splitting under the logo into two limbs (each with an intertwined strand) that pass in front of the logo's lower rim, wrap round its lower outer lobes and curl over them, thin vines looping round the lobes, and gold teardrop leaves on curling stems - swept into bark-perturbed tapered tubes. No dais (open ground). Three parts/materials: `roots` (bark-textured gold), `leaves` (lighter gold with a faint self-glow) and `veins` (a thin, strongly emissive gold-orange strand along the trunk strands and limbs, standing in for a glowing crack pattern). Sized to the shared DVYDRM logo asset (2 units wide), centred at the origin, facing +Z.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-mainframe.mjs from the owner-supplied Mainframe Pass 1-3 SVG/JSON source contract. Shallow hard-surface wall with the exact central DVYDRM logo composition plus a 2.5x modeled continuation field for deep zoom-out coverage, 60 extended raised circuit routes, 46 terminals, 36 vias, four radar assemblies, two chip assemblies, plates, vents, seams, and fasteners. Parts preserve independent circuit, indicator, radar, chip, and logo material families; custom attributes retain route, bank, region, system, and centre-out glow phase identities.

Generated by a throwaway script in this repository (24k-triangle torus knot with a dark glossy PBR material), compressed with @gltf-transform/cli meshopt. Exists to exercise the three-scene module end to end.

Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-reliquary-trees.mjs: the flanking forest for RELIQUARY - two foreground trees at the frame edges (three twisting strands, S-curve lean toward the logo, buttress roots, arching branches), four mid trees and four far trunks, all dark glossy bark wrapped in spiralling gold vines with gold buds. Three parts/materials merged into one mesh each: `bark`, `vines`, `buds`. Every vertex carries `_GLOW_PHASE` (0 at the ground, 1 at the top of each tree) for three-scene's audio glow. Same ground plane (y -1.55) and scale as the golden roots, centred on the origin, facing +Z.

assets.origin: Generated by scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-say-it-glyphs.mjs from the vendored Anton Regular source font at scripts/cinema2-assets/sources/anton/Anton-Regular.ttf. Contains one centered bevelled PBR mesh and one emissive outer-contour LED tube mesh for every drawable printable Basic Latin code point U+0021 through U+007E; U+0020 is represented by metrics only. Metrics and kerning are generated in Cinema2SayItGlyphMetrics.generated.json.
scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-smoke-sprites.mjs (512 px PNG, converted to lossless WebP; the 256 px file is a lanczos downscale)

scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-smoke-volume.mjs (64^3 volume stored as a 64x4096 PNG, converted to lossless WebP because the channels are data; the 32^3 file is the same noise field sampled more coarsely)

scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-studio-environment.mjs (equirectangular Radiance RGBE: dark room with an overhead panel, a bright key softbox, a cool strip light and a magenta accent; 512 px wide for the low tier)

scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-studio-environment.mjs <out> <width> gem (equirectangular Radiance RGBE: a near-black room scattered with small hard lights, so cut glass sparkles facet by facet; 512 px wide for the low tier)

scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-studio-environment.mjs <out> <width> neutral (equirectangular Radiance RGBE: the studio room with every hue removed, so polished surfaces reflect plain white and grey; 512 px wide for the low tier)
scripts/cinema2-assets/generate-wet-concrete.mjs (1024 px PNG, converted to lossless WebP because the channels are data: normal xy, crack mask, roughness; the 512 px file is a lanczos downscale)
